blurb: Guests board 45’ powered catamarans seating up to 49 passengers for dolphin and sightseeing tours, sunset cruises, and special holiday cruises. The boats are open-air with restrooms on board. Private charters are available for special events.
extraNote: Docked under the Sky Bridge on Fort Myers Beach, adjacent to the Marina Village Resort Condominium docks. · Year-round
